The Digital Nomad Visa Index for 2026 has updated income thresholds and durations in 15 countries

The Nomad Hub resource updated the Digital Nomad Visa Index for 2026 on October 10-11. It includes data on financial requirements, durations of stay, the possibility of including family members, and tax regime for 15 countries with specific routes for remote work.

Spain is listed with one of the lowest monthly thresholds in the eurozone: 2442 euros per month, which corresponds to 200% of the minimum wage. The index notes that when recalculated for 12 months, the figure is around 2849 euros. The initial duration is 12 months with the possibility of extension, and families are allowed.

Among other European programs in the index, Portugal is listed (3680 euros per month), Greece (3500 euros), and Hungary (3000 euros). Malta is noted as a route with the longest fixed maximum duration - 48 months with an annual threshold of 42,000 euros. Thailand, under the Destination Thailand Visa, requires confirmation of savings of 500,000 baht with an initial duration of 6 months.

The index notes that in some countries (Argentina, Uruguay), the published minimum income is not specified. The data is updated with references to official sources and verification dates for each country. The threshold for Spain is calculated based on the minimum wage for 2026 set by Real Decreto 126/2026.

📌 Market Cap vs Liquidity: Why a “Big Project” Can Still Be Thin

Main Points
⏺ Market cap is price × circulating supply, but it doesn’t show real tradable depth
⏺ Liquidity tells you how much can be bought/sold without moving price too much
⏺ This post explains why beginners must separate “valuation” from “liquidity”

1️⃣ Market Cap — a snapshot based on last traded price, not cash sitting in the book.
2️⃣ Liquidity — real depth: how much volume the market absorbs without heavy slippage.
3️⃣ Thin Markets — small flows can push price up and create a shiny market cap.
4️⃣ Exit Risk — entering is easy, exiting is hard; selling moves price faster than you expect.
5️⃣ Practical Check — watch volume, order book/pool depth, and spreads, not just market cap.

Final Thoughts

Market cap is the sign on the building. Liquidity is the door. If the door is narrow, exiting cleanly can be impossible.

Spain exempts self-custody wallets from crypto tax reporting

Spain's tax authorities have confirmed that cryptocurrency held in self-custody wallets — where the owner controls the private keys — does not need to be reported under Form 721, the country's disclosure form for foreign-held digital assets. The exemption hinges on one condition: no third party holds the assets on your behalf.

The rule draws a clean line between personal custody and exchange or custodial holdings abroad, which remain reportable. Simple in principle, potentially significant in practice — Spain just gave self-custody a regulatory edge.

📌 Why is Stacks (STX) going up? 

📣 Stacks has gained more than 100% over the past 90 days, backed by institutional Bitcoin Staking that is creating a new use for STX that could grow as more BTC enters future bonding periods. According to CoinGecko data, STX was trading around $0.38 on Oct. 6 after gaining roughly 18% over the previous week. The token had already climbed 108% in the 90 days through Sept. 27.

🌐 Those developments have given traders several Stacks specific catalysts at a time when many major altcoins have struggled to match STX’s gains. Bitcoin Staking is particularly important to the long term case because it gives institutions a way to earn BTC rewards while creating a separate use for STX. However, Bitcoin Staking alone cannot account for the entire 90 day rally on its own. Market conditions and renewed interest in the Stacks ecosystem have contributed to the price action as well. But unlike a short term price catalyst, the staking model creates a measurable link between institutional BTC participation and the amount of STX needed to support it.

➡️ The Genesis Bond has already put that relationship into practice, while Bond 2 and subsequent bonding periods will test whether it can repeat as more Bitcoin enters the program. Bitcoin Staking on Stacks allows BTC holders to earn BTC denominated rewards without changing Bitcoin’s proof of work consensus. Under Stacks’ Proof of Transfer system, miners commit BTC to compete for Stacks blocks and receive STX. The BTC committed through the process becomes the source of rewards distributed through the staking system.

— CONFIRMED NEWS: The long-awaited revelation of Pfizer's secret and highly classified list of side effects for the COVID-19 vaccine

— And the reality is worse than you imagined! They tried to hide this from you!

The disclosure of information on October 9, 2026, brought Pfizer's long-suppressed list of adverse effects before the public eye.

Pharmaceutical companies and their allied media spent four years downplaying concerns; skeptics were branded as "conspiracy theorists" and "science deniers."

This update draws from Pfizer's own compilation of reported side effects—data that was withheld even as the public was assured harms were rare and mild.

The list goes far beyond fever or fatigue; it is a record of serious, deadly, and life-altering health conditions acknowledged by the company itself.

Blood clotting cases include clots that can lead to stroke, heart attack, or pulmonary embolism, plus deep vein thrombosis, hepatic and spinal artery thrombosis, innominate vein thrombosis, and ventricular mural thrombi. Brainstem embolism and thrombosis are also listed as blockages that can result in loss of motor function, breathing, and death.

Hundreds of cardiac arrest cases were recorded; terms like heart failure, cardiogenic shock, myocarditis, and pericarditis describe conditions where the heart becomes inflamed, weakened, or stops working. "Sudden death" is explicitly mentioned.

Neurological cases are no less severe; the list includes acute flaccid myelitis (paralysis resembling polio), hemorrhagic encephalitis and brainstem encephalitis, central nervous system vasculitis, frontal and temporal lobe epilepsy, generalized tonic-clonic seizures, neonatal seizures, epileptic psychosis, facial paralysis, and Hashimoto's encephalopathy. Conditions like acute kidney injury, autoimmune hepatitis, liver damage, pancreatitis, interstitial lung disease, and shingles reactivation can lead to dialysis, scarring, or organ failure. The list also includes multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children and newly onset type 1 diabetes.

Mandatory measures did not spare fertility and infant issues; cases of anti-sperm antibodies and autoimmune orchitis point to immune attacks that may impair male fertility. Cases of fetal distress, low birth weight, stillbirth, neonatal death, and neonatal vein thrombosis describe harms to the fetus and newborn.

This data was known, even as refusal was viewed as betrayal.

That is the charge for October 2026; they knew, they hid the true scope of the matter, and yet they imposed the product on workers, service members, and parents.

Voices close to Trump and others from the Kennedy era at the Department of Health and Human Services had warned that these facts were being buried. Now, with the truth exposed, accountability emerges as the priority.
